content.text: In regions like Nigeria and Ghana, traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-step-step-deployment|payment]] platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-explained-digital-creators-stripe-3|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and PayPal are inaccessible, leaving digital creators stranded. COREMERCH empowers you to bypass these restrictions with robust infrastructure options like Stack 01 and Stack 02, designed to deploy your digital store swiftly. This guide focuses on deploying your digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-20|Cloudflare R2]] Pages for free, utilizing the unmatched capabilities of our Edge Commerce Stack to set you up for success in just 48 hours, while ensuring you maintain complete control over your revenue streams.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

In today's digital economy, reliance on conventional payment platforms can severely hinder your ability to sell products online. Stack 01 and Stack 02 provide a decentralized approach, ensuring that you maintain sovereignty over your infrastructure. With COREMERCH, you leverage tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, eliminating intermediaries and allowing you to accept cryptocurrency payments effortlessly. This independence not only mitigates risks associated with platform failures but also enhances your operational efficiency, enabling you to focus on what matters: your creative work.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin deployment, gather essential tools and resources. First, ensure you have a GitHub account to host your code and a Cloudflare account for managing your DNS and CDN. Next, prepare your digital products, whether they are ebooks, courses, or templates. Make sure you have your NOWPayments account ready to process cryptocurrency payments. Finally, familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which will guide you through the setup process and streamline your deployment. With these components in place, you are set to launch your digital store efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The payment and product delivery pipeline is crucial for your digital store's functionality. Start by deploying your GitHub Pages site, ensuring that it is configured to serve your products. Next, integrate NOWPayments to enable seamless cryptocurrency transactions. After setting up your payment processor, configure your backend using Cloudflare Workers to handle order logic, and use Supabase for order storage. This combination guarantees that once a payment is confirmed on-chain, your customers receive their digital products instantly, creating a smooth purchasing experience.
Sovereignty is yours; no platform dependency means complete control.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With everything in place, it’s time to go live. Conduct thorough testing on the mainnet to ensure that every aspect of your store, from product listings to payment processing, functions flawlessly. Initiate a transaction with a small amount of cryptocurrency to confirm that the payment process works as intended. Monitor your store's performance and customer interactions closely during this initial phase. Once all systems are operational, start promoting your store to your audience. Use your social media channels and networks to drive traffic to your newly launched digital store.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is up and running, consider how to scale effectively. Start by analyzing customer interactions and sales data to identify which products are performing best. Use this information to optimize your marketing strategies and expand your product offerings. Additionally, explore integrating additional features like email notifications and analytics tools to enhance customer engagement. With Stack 02, you can further refine your operations, adding more products and utilizing advanced configurations like SPF/DKIM/DMARC for secure email communication. This proactive approach will help you grow your digital store sustainably.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, leverage COREMERCH's infrastructure. Use Cloudflare Pages for hosting, integrate NOWPayments for payment processing, and ensure you have a backend logic setup with either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This approach allows you to operate independently and securely, without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Deploy your store in just 48 hours with Stack 02, fully tested.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to expand further, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). With this robust solution, you can deploy your store in 48 hours, fully tested and supported. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options and elevate your digital commerce experience.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account and set up a Cloudflare account. 2. Prepare your digital products for upload. 3. Register for a NOWPayments account to accept cryptocurrency. 4. Deploy your GitHub Pages site to host your store. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. 6. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 7. Test your store on the mainnet with a small transaction. 8. Start promoting your digital store to attract customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, use GitHub Pages for hosting, integrate NOWPayments for processing, and implement backend logic with Cloudflare Workers. This setup ensures you have a fully operational store without reliance on traditional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours to deploy. Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages and Workers, deployed in 48 hours, and includes additional features like Supabase for data storage and end-to-end testing.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are viable options for hosting your digital product store. They provide reliable infrastructure with free hosting capabilities, allowing you to maintain control over your digital commerce.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?
Stack 01 deployment takes approximately 4-6 hours when following the Sovereign Blueprint, ensuring you have a functioning digital store ready to accept payments.
What payment methods are supported by NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies for your products, ensuring flexibility for your customers.
